Worker05's published source-review head `b44430c9230e62f9d9d73154484311b77442e73e` declares the shard complete, but at least one no-change disposition defers curation that the campaign already authorizes rather than documenting an unavailable scientific prerequisite.

Affected case: `KG_CASE:b58f2778ba8c8905faf5cddf634ff4d5059978baa1b2489af2eb4db7f7e9fef1`, MediaDive ingredient1382, Grace's Insect Medium. Existing source owner: `data/ingredients/unmapped/Graces_Insect_Medium.yaml`, SHA256 `98d818debe40f93d28b7c08b2a7437b6a3c8566e12c857aa7f42fd3c1cdafa3e`.

The [committed decision](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/b44430c9230e62f9d9d73154484311b77442e73e/reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-05/media/decisions.json) explicitly binds the source to Sigma G8142 and cites the manufacturer's complete formula. Its no-change and missing-requirement fields say to curate that formula and review component identities. There is no proposal, and no distinct missing evidence for the whole supplied product is identified.

The [manufacturer formula](https://www.sigmaaldrich.cn/deepweb/assets/sigmaaldrich/product/documents/172/423/g8142for.pdf) distinguishes G8142 liquid1x from G9771 powder, including bicarbonate treatment. Worker evidence `MEDIA-SIGMA-G8142-FORMULA` retains the PDF at SHA256 `7a07a208abd686522d82c3d61bc682af4e377ebd226bdbe786c2f9e84727b140`. This is a lead for supplied-product curation, not approval of any generic medium equivalence or every component identity.

MAPPING_SEMANTICS sections3 and6 and the add-media workflow distinguish whole preparation identity from component grounding. Named ungrounded parts may remain explicit; a missing component CURIE is not by itself proof that an evidence-defined preparation must stay entirely uncurated. The campaign requires justified curation, not only a list of future curation tasks.

Please reassess this case and the other worker05 no-change dispositions whose stated blocker is simply to curate, define or reconcile an already identified formulation. For each, either prepare a concrete evidence-backed proposal through the existing proposal workflow, or record the exact unresolved scientific fact and the primary-source searches actually attempted. Preserve historical/source scope, competing-owner boundaries, raw labels, prior holds, and separate full-payload/release review. Do not invent a catalog variant, infer a complete formula from a source name, merge owners, treat all product names as resolved, or approve roles.

For G8142 specifically, verify the source-to-product attribution and all current owner occurrences before choosing whether the existing owner can be specialized or a separate source-qualified preparation is needed. Transcribe only supported formulation claims; preserve any uncertainty in individual component form or quantity explicitly. Independent re-review must cover the revised disposition/proposal and final head.

Deduplication: the complete652-visible-issue all-state snapshot and relevant Grace/G8142/worker05 title/body matches contained no exact completeness finding. #1176 and #1177 cover separate peptone/Sea Salts defects. This issue does not reopen those or supersede a scientific hold.

comments.body:
A bounded provenance finding in the published Worker05 correction is recorded before fixing it: **CATALASE-PROVENANCE-001**. The Catalase proposal says that JCM117 directly supplies the historical C-10 spelling and 60 mg addition. Its declared direct JCM117 capture instead says “Nothing found.” The separate TOGO M109 capture supplies `original_media_id: JCM_M117`, literal `Catalase (Sigma C--10)`, 60 mg and filtration context.

Correct the attribution to [TOGO M109](https://togomedium.org/medium/M109) and disclose the unsuccessful direct JCM lookup. Preserve the historical catalog spelling, all raw source/history, the distinct verified C9322 product, and the unresolved historical species/C100-equivalence holds. This changes provenance wording, not chemical identity or source transcription. Deduplication read the full current bodies/comments of #1193 and #1201; neither already records this exact finding.

Exact finding: `.temp/all-unmatched-20261107/integration/final-same-target-reconciliation-v1/finding-catalase-provenance-v1/finding.json`, SHA256 `63159e7a7ce6be15a20f35ae62c42e2e9aabc55b3f319e1c4b688c17a86e2a4f`. No maintained candidate has been applied. The successor requires independent review.

Reviewed W05 head `43f7cf6e8681fa617b5d6d3529d94d537ca01f0d`, frozen base `e000d66dd26ab053e9b17ce7bf8d3c873c3dde99`. The preserved external review is `20261108T071144Z-worker08-independent-worker05-full188-payload138`, YAML SHA256 `bdde7d4101546e0e43f0752e4587c4d0c3a0fb43f887d82eee2d869edd5c06b0`. All 188 case-decision hashes and all 138 selected payload hashes were independently rebound to the published core; the sealed scientific review remains needs_curation. This comment records bounded follow-up before author correction, not approval or application.

The final independent review retains eighteen findings. This bounded successor plan keeps their IDs and exact payloads; unresolved family comparisons remain scientific holds rather than being forced into equality or artificial distinctness.

- **W05-CR-F01** — Two HEPES stock owners assert an unsupported substance distinction: Do not infer distinct HEPES stock identities from receiving-medium pH or source numbers. Preserve partial source preparations and all occurrences. Neither equivalence nor selection of a winning source owner is established; coordinate the shared family review before final stable identity choice. Routing: family-findings-triage-v1; #1193 cross-reference.
- **W05-CR-F02** — Wolfe elixir duplication uses unresolved hydration as proof of distinction: Unknown MnSO4 water count may be one; it is not proof of distinctness from explicit monohydrate. Preserve both complete source recipes and the unresolved bridge. Coordinate C’s W10 mineral/Wolfe family scope; do not mint/merge or pick a winner from richer metadata. Routing: family-findings-triage-v1; #1193 cross-reference.
- **W05-CR-F03** — Four 95% ethanol owners are distinguished only by receiving recipes: Receiving K1/hemin/menadione preparations do not distinguish the ethanol reagent when excluded from its owner. Preserve all seventeen original occurrences, unknown percent basis/remaining fraction/denaturants, and a conditional comparison. Do not force equality or map unspecified 95% material to an aqueous-v/v ontology term. Routing: family-findings-triage-v1; #1193 cross-reference.
- **W05-CR-F04** — Generic fatty-acid mixture aliases remain eligible on a recipe-specific stock: Retire or explicitly source-scope the two generic fatty-mixture identity aliases, preserving the JCM266 preparation and raw source history. Exact recipe differences establish that a generic token cannot globally choose JCM266; no new resolver/code is authorized. Routing: 1180.
- **W05-CR-F05** — Thiamine stock prose generalizes filtration beyond the source: Correct only the new universal filtration attribution: JCM403 specifies the two inputs, while NBRC1321/JCM1125 separately state filtration. Preserve shared formulation, original history and source-specific processing; no forced new owner. Routing: 1193.
- **W05-CR-F06** — Known wrong thiamine-dihydrate CAS remains despite a feasible bounded removal: Prepare the bounded removal of CAS13465-05-9 from Thiamine-hcl_X_2_H2o.yaml, with exact preimage/history and no invented replacement. Keep CHEBI132751 identity and supported chemistry. Check the coordinator’s latest accepted intake before adding a duplicate proposal. Routing: 268.
- **W05-CR-F07** — New alias assertions use campaign-only provenance instead of their exact source: Bind thirteen new aliases on eleven owners to their actual recipe/supplier sources; preserve creation-process provenance in history and all older evidence. Correct the NaCOOH caption to actual TOGO M3211 Formate medium. This is assertion traceability, not a new schema rule requiring URLs on every historical synonym. Routing: 1193.
- **W05-CR-F08** — Inherited active alias conflicts remain on reviewed owners: Separate literal MgSO2/protonation conflicts from generic hydration and concentration scope. Preserve source-proven damaged labels where warranted; do not globally normalize malformed formulas. The nine Mg labels and Nicotinate require individual form evidence; four concentration labels on Riboflavin/Hepes/Ki/Fe_Iii_Citrate require original stock-versus-dose context. Do not infer solvents or complete formulations. Routing: #1229 residual-form aliases and #1230 concentration/preparation aliases.
- **W05-MAT-001** — Generic soy owner still asserts branded product and alternative aliases: Apply the already sourced Phytone scope decision and its three exact Soy_Peptone alias withdrawals, then separately address retained Soytone/Bacto Soytone product scope against authentic history/manufacturer evidence. Reconcile W08/W10 competing owner deltas without mergers, count redistribution or automatic shared-ID memberships. Routing: 1212.
- **W05-MAT-002** — Fish-sperm DNA owner retains generic and conflicting tissue aliases: Retain the fish-sperm/SERVA source identity and reject the unsupported generic-DNA or conflicting-thymus exact-identity aliases with raw provenance preserved. Do not infer species, length/counterion, reverse the herring tombstone or resurrect the false absent-formula/class premise of #322. Routing: fish-sperm-generic-aliases.
- **W05-MAT-003** — Known truncated concentration token remains on generic Peptone: Retain Peptone (0.01 % as rejected provenance, without reconstructing a preparation, percentage basis or supplier. Preserve Peptones and source/organism holds. This narrow alias correction does not resolve the separate eighteen existing component-reference and current cross-shard Peptone identity dependencies. Routing: 1193; preserve historical 208/218 context.
- **W05-MAT-004** — Bacto owner retains a fish-product alias despite the mammalian product boundary: Extend the product-alias repair to Fish peptone (Fluka), which conflicts with Bacto’s evidenced mammalian product scope. Preserve the exact text/source/history; do not infer a Fluka product, move counts or decide every other generic meat/mixture alias. Routing: 1176.
- **W05-MAT-005** — Metadata tokens remain in the Catalase and soy synonym channels: Actual native probes show all three Properties strings already nonresolving in both MIM and Claw76c1. Optional provenance-preserving REJECTED_LABEL classification is not a live resolver fix, acceptance blocker or reason to change filters. Preserve the original peer observation rather than rewriting it. Routing: 1193 qualification only.
- **W05-MAT-006** — Optional typed sucrose component link is available: Optional exact sucrose component link may improve the partial 20% w/v stock; §6 permits named UNMAPPED components. No required global component-grounding rule, solvent guess, concentration reinterpretation or extra role approval follows. Routing: 1193 qualification only.
- **W05-MAT-007** — Catalase provenance claims a direct JCM source although the captured endpoint is empty: Already filed exact source-attribution defect: substantive TOGO M109 preserves JCM117 lineage, while retrieved direct JCM117 says Nothing found. Check the coordinator’s exact reconciled Catalase v2 before duplicating the fix. Keep C--10/C9322/C100 identities and human-NCIT exclusion separate. Routing: 1193 comment6718503816; coordinator Catalase v2.
- **W05-MEDIA-F01** — Active Marine Broth mapping evidence retains the superseded agar-equivalence premise: Correct the retained active mapping-evidence claim that commercial broth differs from agar only by gelling agent. Preserve original assertion historically and bind the actual manufacturer broth formula; do not undo the supported component correction or approve release. Routing: 1208.
- **W05-MEDIA-F02** — EMJH quantitative curation is deferred by a false basis conflict: Transcribe the five explicit approximate basal amounts with the manufacturer’s per-liter basis and performance-adjustment footnote. 2.3/0.9≈2.55556 g/L agrees with the approximate 2.555 g/L sum, so that arithmetic alone is not a scientific blocker. Do not infer final enriched-medium concentrations, exact lot composition, phosphate hydrate or thiamine salt. Routing: 1193.
- **W05-MEDIA-F03** — Cooked-meat evidence claim is attached to an unrelated environmental-noise PDF: Withdraw the positive USDA1998/chapter14 attribution from the active evidence index and dependent evidence links. Preserve the exact unrelated EPA noise PDF and retrieval metadata as an unsuccessful/mismatched retrieval. An actually retrieved relevant source may replace the claim, but the two independently supported component-reference withdrawals need not be reversed. Routing: 1193; linked owner obligations748.

The current exact native probe qualifies MAT-005: the two Catalase Properties strings and one Soy_Peptone Properties string are already filtered in both maintained MIM and pinned Claw76c1. No current exported-alias defect is inferred. MAT-006 is also optional; named ungrounded components are permitted. These qualifications supplement the immutable review rather than rewriting its findings.

All new mapping-evidence assertions must also satisfy #1226's human-only enum distinction, preserving genuinely historical human evidence and the separate component-evidence enum semantics. Exact science does not become approved through a type correction. Preserve the existing Peptone identity/component-reference coupling (eighteen historical dependents plus current cross-shard proposals), and the Phytone, Bacto and other shared-owner reconciliation decisions; do not silently retarget component owners.

Prepare an immutable report-only successor accounting for all 188 original source cases and every one of the 138 selected original proposals. Add feasible bounded proposals (such as the false-CAS removal) or state the real remaining fact; do not hide authorized work behind an unrelated hold. Additional or superseded proposals may change the final count. Preserve the prior core files, exact captures, review lineage, failures and source-specific limitations. Revalidate every final payload through existing strict schema, guarded serialization and full-overlay partonomy, then obtain independent whole-payload/source re-review. No corpus application, new gate/code, approval widening or shared export rebuild is part of this author task.

Independent follow-up to the preserved W06 review `20261108T071757Z-w06-ten-unions-independent-metadata-v2` (authoritative YAML SHA256 `01a7f358f637ce22e8db311ca290c92e010fad757120f1ae43e89265b1742e32`). I verified all 670 manifest-listed proof files and independently matched the ten reviewed payloads to the active 37-candidate set. These are unapplied candidates, not owner or release approvals. Original reviews, source captures and histories remain immutable.

**W06-TU-004 — a bounded BSA source-context correction.** The current reconciled `Bovine_Serum_Albumin.yaml` candidate SHA256 `d9c58b2297f6aef28850dac72e708f3a0df3eac949693ba8d2edd1c1de26f9bc` preserves a new W05 note at `supplied_form[5].notes`: “manufacturer/catalog and final ADC/OADC volume not established.” This entry's case70, `CM_NAME:8ba1df295abb60b7fb8cd7e12f80b861e3d2e7634dd64e3bfb7e88df0db0fd08`, is [TOGO M194 / JCM201 BSK medium](https://togomedium.org/medium/M194), not ADC/OADC.

The complete source capture SHA256 `84717c209dda5e9fc18a4ee5b1456ee655f243d31013b41b0d118ff17d03bdb9` explicitly lists Bovine albumin, Fraction V,50g. It has mixed volume-bearing ingredients and final rabbit-serum supplementation, without a justified exact final volume for a protein-concentration calculation. Replace only the irrelevant ADC/OADC context with truthful BSK context and the unresolved final preparation volume. Preserve literal Fraction V, unknown supplier/catalogue,50g source amount, recipe membership and source history. Do not convert this amount to50g/L.

This is distinct from #1222's JCM220/MediaDive3888 occurrence quantity. Preserve its independently reviewed WITHHOLD correction and all other full-companion claims. The BSK wording repair neither re-approves that quantity nor establishes inherited A7030 processing/purity claims. Record the narrow correction in a new immutable reconciled candidate and obtain independent review; no owner, role or release approval is granted here.
